name: Design Communication and Presentation
description: Design communication typologies and structures. Connotative and denotative semantics in visual communication. Visual language and identity design. Role of typography and photography in design communications. Layout design for print and digital media. Influence of media on communication style. Lighting techniques in product photography for highlighting form, material, texture and function. Compositions and framing in product photography. Staging of design artefacts for effective communication. Storyboarding and storytelling techniques in visual and mixed media. Best practices in the use of contemporary technologies for design communication and presentations. Design critique methods and feedback articulation practices. Professional practices in visual and verbal communication.
